_comment: Single source of truth for test users, shared by all three frameworks.
These are the five users produced by `yarn db:seed:dev` in cypress-realworld-app,
taken verbatim from its data/database-seed.json. Every seeded user has the same
plaintext password, 's3cret' (the bcrypt hash in the seed file decodes to it, and
the app's own specs use that literal).
If the app is re-seeded with `yarn db:seed` (which regenerates random data), these
ids and usernames change. Re-run `yarn db:seed:dev` to get this exact set back.
